# Event flow

How a fact gets into the platform and what reacts to it. Every inbound signal becomes a canonical
event on the bus first; nothing reacts to a webhook directly.

**Generated from:** `src/events/canonical.mjs`, `src/events/bus.mjs`, `src/adapters/`, `src/handlers/`, `src/workflows/`

## Journey spine

The ordered backbone of a client's life in the system. Side events and billing events hang off it
but do not advance it.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  s0["entry.captured"]
  s1["survey.submitted"]
  s0 --> s1
  s2["diagnostic.paid"]
  s1 --> s2
  s3["analysis.completed"]
  s2 --> s3
  s4["booking.created"]
  s3 --> s4
  s5["booking.rescheduled"]
  s4 --> s5
  s6["booking.cancelled"]
  s5 --> s6
  s7["booking.noshow"]
  s6 --> s7
  s8["call.completed"]
  s7 --> s8
  s9["decision.rendered"]
  s8 --> s9
  s10["deposit.paid"]
  s9 --> s10
  s11["sale.closed"]
  s10 --> s11
  s12["round.started"]
  s11 --> s12
  s13["round.submitted"]
  s12 --> s13
  s14["round.approved"]
  s13 --> s14
  s15["round.funded"]
  s14 --> s15
  s16["round.closeout"]
  s15 --> s16
  s17["file.finalized"]
  s16 --> s17
```
